mapper.insert: insert into chat_message(user_id, question, answer, time) values(#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{time})
mapper.select: select * from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} order by time asc

SELECT cm.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, count(*) as messageCount, (SELECT question FROM chat_message WHERE user_id = cm.user_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) as lastQuestion, (SELECT time FROM chat_message WHERE user_id = cm.user_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) as lastTime FROM chat_message cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.user_id = u.id GROUP BY cm.user_id ORDER BY lastTime DESC
